limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work2 lab is shared with other DOC-030 walkthrough agents, and record counts moved during the run. Show-flag totals were compared with the lab database read just before and just after each Preview total. The walkthrough created only records named DOC-030 search V-C04 1790331205958 and two doc030.search.* accounts, changed no organization settings, and archived only its own fixture Field. It deleted only its own saved searches and views. walkthrough.json lists every fixture.

Fixtures were written through the lab API as Daniel Okafor. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role. A Business User check (Lena Vogel, fresh magic link) confirmed that /search opens the Portal. The fixture Field was archived through the API, standing in for the Administrator action the guide mentions.

Failed reads were produced by aborting requests in the browser, not by a server fault. The saved-search open error was produced by blocking the Field catalog request while selecting a saved search with a Field condition.
Under Match any a Show condition set to Yes matched every non-archived reachable Contract. Archived Contracts stay out unless Show archived is Yes, which fits the guide's default-exclusion sentence.

Product bug, outside the guide's steps: the header list reads or and a leading - as operators, while See all results turns the same text into All of these words, where they are plain words. "word -other" listed Alpha, Bravo, Delta and Echo in the header but only Charlie on the results page; "word or other" listed six records in the header and only Charlie on the page. The guide does not tell readers to use these as operators.

Not checked: column widths in a saved view, the transient Updating… state, the 25 saved-search and 25 saved-view limits, and rapid-click issue #751 (tracked separately, as the registry says). An earlier full run (walkthrough-attempt1.json) had two failures from shared-lab count drift and a reviewer script race; both checks were made drift-safe and passed in the recorded run.
